claim.claim-text: 1. An adapter for mating a container of aerosol precursor composition with an aerosol delivery device having a refillable reservoir, the adapter comprising:

a body defining a passageway between the container and the aerosol delivery device when the container is mated to the aerosol delivery device using the adapter, the passageway being for transfer of aerosol precursor composition from the container into the refillable reservoir; and a valve located within the body and configured to be depressed during engagement of the container with the aerosol delivery device, wherein upon depression of the valve, aerosol precursor composition is thereby allowed to flow from the container through the passageway to the refillable reservoir.

2. The adapter of Claim 1, wherein the body has a container-side end and an opposing, device-side end, the container-side end configured to sealably connect with the container, and the device-side end configured to sealably connect with the aerosol delivery device, and the body defining the passageway between the container-side and device-side ends for transfer of the aerosol precursor composition.

3. The adapter of Claim 2, wherein the adapter defines separate and distinct filling and airflow ports, the filling port for transfer of aerosol precursor composition into the refillable reservoir, the airflow port for a flow of air through a portion of the aerosol delivery device; and wherein the valve includes a valve body that is depressed during engagement of the container and the aerosol delivery device, the valve body including a first valve member that opens the passageway for aerosol precursor composition to flow therethrough when the valve body is depressed, and a second valve member with a matching portion receivable in an inner cavity of the airflow port to close the airflow port when the valve body is depressed.

4. The adapter of Claim 3, wherein the aerosol delivery device includes an adapter protrusion defining the airflow port, and the device-side end includes a nozzle within which the valve is movably positioned, the nozzle including a cavity sized to receive therein at least a portion of the valve when the valve and aerosol delivery device are disengaged, and the adapter protrusion when the valve and aerosol delivery device are engaged.

5. The adapter of Claim 4, wherein the nozzle includes a spout containing a micropatterned internal surface for transfer of aerosol precursor composition from the container into the aerosol delivery device, and the filling port is sized to receive the spout when the valve and aerosol delivery device are engaged.

6. The adapter of Claim 2, wherein the container-side end defines an intermediary reservoir between the passageway and the container upon connection with the container, the intermediary reservoir defining a compressible body configured to receive aerosol precursor composition from the container, and in response to being compressed, force at least some of the aerosol precursor composition from the intermediary reservoir into the device-side end via the passageway.
7. The adapter of Claim 2, wherein the container-side end is threaded and thereby threadable onto the container to connect the container-side end with the container.
8. The adapter of Claim 2, wherein the container-side end defines a sheath sized to receive at least a portion of the container inside the sheath to connect the container-side end with the container.

10. The method of Claim 9, wherein the body has a container-side end and an opposing, device-side end, the container-side end configured to sealably connect with the container, and the device-side end configured to sealably connect with the aerosol delivery device, and the body defining the passageway between the container-side and device-side ends for transfer of the aerosol precursor composition.

11. 12. The method of Claim 11, wherein the aerosol delivery device includes an adapter protrusion defining the airflow port, and the device-side end includes a nozzle within which the valve is movably positioned, the nozzle including a cavity sized to receive therein at least a portion of the valve when the valve and aerosol delivery device are disengaged, and the adapter protrusion when the valve and aerosol delivery device are engaged.

13. 14. The method of Claim 10, wherein the container-side end defines an intermediary reservoir between the passageway and the container upon connection with the container, the intermediary reservoir defining a compressible body configured to receive aerosol precursor composition from the container, and in response to being compressed, force at least some of the aerosol precursor composition from the intermediary reservoir into the device-side end via the passageway.
15. The method of Claim 10, wherein the container-side end is threaded and thereby threadable onto the container to connect the container-side end with the container.
